title: 'We Don't Know Politics, We Know How To Work', Says Kejriwal | Ghoshnapatra | ABP News
description: In the ABP News's exclusive show 'Ghoshnapatra', Delhi's chief minister Arvind Kejriwal said that AAP don’t know political games, they only know how to work for the welfare of people. The Delhi CM further said that in past five years, AAP worked day and night for the people of Delhi.
